meta.title: Textarea
meta.lead: The native `<textarea>` is styled like the input for consistency.

blocks.label: Textarea example
blocks.demo: <article aria-label="Textarea example" class="component"><textarea aria-label="Professional short bio" name="bio" placeholder="Write a professional short bio..."></textarea></article>
blocks.code:
<textarea
  name="bio"
  placeholder="Write a professional short bio..."
  aria-label="Professional short bio"
>
</textarea>

blocks.label: Disabled example
blocks.demo: <article aria-label="Disabled example" class="component"><textarea aria-label="Disabled textarea" disabled="" name="disabled">Disabled</textarea></article>

blocks.label: Disabled example
blocks.demo: <article aria-label="Disabled example" class="component"><textarea aria-label="Read-only textarea" name="read-only" readonly="">Read-only</textarea></article>

blocks.label: Validation states example
blocks.demo: <article aria-label="Validation states example" class="component"><textarea aria-invalid="false" name="valid" placeholder="Valid">Valid</textarea><textarea aria-invalid="true" name="invalid" placeholder="Invalid">Invalid</textarea></article>
blocks.code:
<textarea name="valid" aria-invalid="false">
  Valid
</textarea>

<textarea name="invalid" aria-invalid="true">
  Invalid
</textarea>

blocks.md: Helper texts, defined with `<small>` below the textarea, inherit the validation state color.

blocks.label: Validation states example
blocks.demo: <article aria-label="Validation states example" class="component"><textarea aria-describedby="valid-helper" aria-invalid="false" name="valid" placeholder="Valid">Valid</textarea><small id="valid-helper">Looks good!</small><textarea aria-describedby="invalid-helper" aria-invalid="true" name="invalid" placeholder="Invalid">Invalid</textarea><small id="invalid-helper">Please provide a valid value!</small></article>
blocks.code:
<textarea
  name="valid"
  aria-invalid="false"
  aria-describedby="valid-helper"
>
  Valid
</textarea>
<small id="valid-helper">Looks good!</small>

<textarea
  name="invalid"
  aria-invalid="true"
  aria-describedby="invalid-helper"
>
  Invalid
</textarea>
<small id="invalid-helper">
  Please provide a valid value!
</small>
